title: Chapitre 21 : Conditionnel Réel
description: Parler de ce qui se passe si une condition est remplie.

sentences.french: Si tu manges, tu es content.
sentences.english: If you eat, you are happy.
If I am hungry, I eat.

sentences.french: Si vous venez, vous voyez Marc.
sentences.english: If you (plural/formal) come, you see Marc.

si.explanation: Conjunction meaning 'if'. Used for real conditions (Present -> Present or Future).
